method: Read-only comparison of original implementation, prepared patch, final production diff, full verification/cold persistence code, authored tests and raw logs; SHA-256 and byte-length verification. No test reruns or App/Agent/user-data operations.

conclusions.detail: New path requires the original dispatched restore, settled operation, recorded location and same saved location identity. The archive branch retains its original path and returns; this is not a new archive/restore action.

Calls complete recycle::verify_at(saved,false): both parent identities, exact linked registration/HEAD/branch, other-path absence, material and index. Identity::matches alone excludes HEAD/branch, so the explicit comparisons remain necessary and present.

Captured full SavedLocation includes current revision and availability; current status/request/completed/recycle intent must still match under manager lock. Verification-time changes reject publication. Allowed higher revision at initial capture is not normalized away in the final CAS.

Uses current revision+1, saves canonical location and exact operation together through existing metadata CAS, then returns. Verification failure remains unknown with actual fixed code and preserved identity/material; no move/delete/reset or historical cwd update.

Read original four failures: one normal cold-success no-op and three missing fresh diagnostic outcomes. These are one missing branch, not four separate defects or three unsafe approvals. Final six pass including two cold reloads, replacement/HEAD/material negatives and two controlled late-result interleavings.
Author logs show existing recycle 12/12, cargo fmt exit0 and required clippy exit0. Green and related execution receipts have the same three source hashes before and after, matching current bytes.

boundaries: Author executed the temporary Git/in-memory MetaStore tests; reviewer inspected their evidence and did not independently rerun them.
Controlled callbacks prove two specified interleavings, not exhaustive OS scheduling races.
Strict material/index/HEAD checks may reject externally changed restored files; repair does not weaken this protection or overwrite those changes.
Installed native symptom belongs to root; repaired source still needs combined integration/candidate/installation and actual native recheck.
No new claims about other Agents, Windows, H17 acceptance or global H15 completeness.
